summary: Bridge the legacy workspace page's in-memory owner token into the shared workspace-power client so its lifecycle and status panels remain usable without reintroducing localStorage token writes.
evidence: The legacy workspace page keeps its owner token in #owner-token memory and does not have IcarusClient, while workspace_power_ui.js now correctly refuses unauthenticated reads and mutations.
A browser regression consequently reported UNKNOWN power status where the authenticated legacy page should show OFF.
next_action: Expose the existing in-memory credential through one immutable page accessor, let workspace power consume that accessor, and verify status refresh and retry lifecycle.
